name: LINE group contract read-only access
scope: Allow verified current members of the bound LINE group to inspect the frozen contract PDF
Keep all counterparty details, identity upload, signature, and submission controls signer-only
Prevent read-only viewers from creating designated-signer first-open evidence

dataIsolation.guard: Authorization is evaluated against the contract's own bound LINE group and designated signer; no tenant data is copied.

definitionOfDone: A verified current group member can inspect the protected frozen PDF in read-only mode
A group member who is not the designated signer cannot expose or execute signing controls
Server-side submission rejects a non-signer before signature or identity evidence storage
Users outside the bound group remain denied
Only the designated signer advances first-open and signing evidence
